Rumi — which voice?

Six phrases, every Castilian voice available, at the speeds that matter. Headphones if you have them.

Rumi now ships the top row: Ximena at 35% slow. That is the walk speed, the default, and the one she spends nearly all her time in.

The thing to check. Compare the first three rows — same voice, three speeds. 35% is a lot of slow, and asking a neural voice to drag smears its consonants, which is itself a common cause of "the accent sounds off". If 35% sounds mushy to you, say 20 or 25 and it is a ten-minute regeneration.

Rabbit speed plays the same recordings faster, so it sits around 19% slow with a slight lift in pitch. Turtle is unchanged and still reads word by word.
